projects.title: Find your community solar farm
projects.subtitle: Join the thousands of renters, homeowners, and businesses who save on their energy costs by subscribing to local solar farms. The community solar projects below are available to you based on your zip code.

project.freeCancelDays: Free to cancel with {days} days notice.
project.giftCardWhenSignUp: $75 Gift card when you sign up
project.savingsExplanation: Your estimated share and environmental impact are based on your monthly electric bill.
project.noCancellationFeesExplanation: No cancellation fees apply to this project.
project.cancellationExplanation: For cancellations, contact {email} or call {phone} at least {days} days in advance.
project.billingExplanation: In the dual-billing system, you will receive two electricity bills, one from your utility provider and one from the solar provider. The utility provider will bill you for the electricity you use, minus the solar credits from your solar farm share. PureSky will bill you only for the 10% discount.
project.energizedDescription: This project is energized and producing power.

info.discount: This percentage represents your savings on electricity costs compared to standard utility rates.
info.status: Indicates whether the project is currently active and accepting new subscribers.
info.creditScore: The minimum credit score required to qualify for this project. 'None' means no credit check is required.
